sar.narrative: Customer C06710, holder of card C06710-K1, is the subject of this report regarding suspicious online transactions totaling $276.35 across two separate events. Between 2016-11-20 14:39 and 2016-12-02 10:38, transactions of $184.19 (3473057, 2016-11-20 14:39) and $92.16 (3506095, 2016-12-02 10:38) were executed on the card from handset device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' while routing through an anonymous proxy. The same device profile was used on 27 other customers' cards in the same period (including C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2), all behind anonymous or hidden proxies and flagged as new devices. During the session for the $92.16 purchase, the one-time passcode sent to the cardholder's registered phone was not completed. When contacted separately, the cardholder stated they did not make the transactions and still holds the card. The activity is suspicious because the device profile was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window, with 4 closed cases on cards using this profile confirmed as fraud under an undocumented pattern. Furthermore, 8 of the 8 most similar closed cases, including CC-0849, CC-3035, CC-2971, and CC-2985, were confirmed fraud. In response, the bank has recommended blocking card C06710-K1, created a case, monitored connected cards, filed this report, and escalated the matter to an analyst.
